summary: Support the legacy __proto__ setter, including silent ignore of invalid prototype values.

semantics.invalid_proto: if value is neither Object nor null, return undefined without changing prototype
semantics.primitive_this: after validation, non-object this returns undefined

caveats: This differs from Object.setPrototypeOf, which throws on an invalid proto argument.
Assignment expression result is still the RHS due assignment-expression semantics, even though the setter itself returns undefined.
